```{r Rosters 2026}
C <- Sys.time()
league_id <- "u9f8f7o9mavp4dt1"
all_rosters_data <- data.frame()

for (period in 1:174) {
  cat("Processing period", period, "of 174\n")
  roster_url <- paste0("https://www.fantrax.com/fxea/general/getTeamRosters?leagueId=", league_id, "&period=", period)
  response <- GET(roster_url, add_headers(Cookie = paste0("JSESSIONID=")))
  if (status_code(response) == 200) {
    roster_json <- content(response, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
    roster_data <- fromJSON(roster_json, flatten = TRUE)
      rosters <- roster_data$rosters
  for (i in 1:length(rosters)) {
      team_name <- rosters[[i]]$teamName
      roster_items <- rosters[[i]]$rosterItems
      if (!is.null(roster_items) && nrow(roster_items) > 0) {
        roster_items$team_name <- team_name
        roster_items$period <- period
        all_rosters_data <- rbind(all_rosters_data, roster_items)}}} 
      else {warning(paste("Failed to fetch data for period", period, "- Status code:", status_code(response)))}
  Sys.sleep(0.1)}

all_rosters_data <- all_rosters_data %>%
  filter(status != "MINORS") %>%
  rename(PlayerID = id,
       Position = position,
       Status = status,
       Team = team_name,
       Period = period) %>%
  mutate(Year = 2026)

A <- Sys.time()
sheet_write(data = all_rosters_data, ss = "1yQFnD0MK0cjO68_Mri6N115EmblyDW7Bza2hbY9Rerg", sheet = "Rosters_2026")
2
B <- Sys.time()-A
D <- Sys.time()-C
print(B)
print(D)

rm(list = ls())
```

```{r Team Stats By Period}
Rosters2022 <- range_speedread(ss = "1yQFnD0MK0cjO68_Mri6N115EmblyDW7Bza2hbY9Rerg", sheet = "Rosters_2022")

Rosters2026 <- range_speedread(ss = "1yQFnD0MK0cjO68_Mri6N115EmblyDW7Bza2hbY9Rerg", sheet = "Rosters_2026")
Rosters <- rbind(Rosters2021,Rosters2022,Rosters2023,Rosters2024,Rosters2025,Rosters2026)
remove(Rosters2021, Rosters2022, Rosters2023, Rosters2024, Rosters2025, Rosters2026)
Schedule <- read_sheet(ss = "1yQFnD0MK0cjO68_Mri6N115EmblyDW7Bza2hbY9Rerg", sheet = "Schedule")
Players <- read_sheet(ss = "1yQFnD0MK0cjO68_Mri6N115EmblyDW7Bza2hbY9Rerg", sheet = "Players")

GameData <- load_nba_player_box(2021:2025)
GameData <- GameData %>%
  filter(!team_display_name %in% c("Team LeBron", "Team Durant", "Team Giannis", "Western Conf All-Stars", "Eastern Conf All-Stars", "Team Shaq", "Team Chuck", "Team Candace", "Team Kenny")) %>%
  filter(season_type == 2) %>%
  filter(game_id != 401734908 & game_id != 401607495)

ScheduleLongA <- Games %>%
  select(TeamA, Year, Period) %>%
  distinct()
ScheduleLongB <- Games %>%
  mutate(TeamA = TeamB) %>%
  select(TeamA, Year, Period) %>%
  distinct()
ScheduleLong <- rbind(ScheduleLongA, ScheduleLongB)
remove(ScheduleLongA, ScheduleLongB)
ScheduleLong <- ScheduleLong %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(TeamA != "Overseas Players One") %>%
  filter(TeamA != "Overseas Players Two") %>%
  left_join(IllegalRosterPeriods, by = c('TeamA' = 'Team', 'Year', 'Period')) %>%
  filter(Illegal == 1)

GetGameStats <- function(i) {
  
  TeamA <- ScheduleLong$TeamA[i]
  GamePeriod <- ScheduleLong$Period[i]
  GameYear <- ScheduleLong$Year[i]
  Dates <- Schedule %>%
    filter(Year == GameYear) %>%
    filter(Period == GamePeriod) %>%
    select(-Period)
  TeamAResults <- Rosters %>%
    filter(Team == TeamA) %>%
    filter(Year == GameYear) %>%
    filter(Status == "ACTIVE") %>%
    filter(Period %in% Dates$Day) %>%
    left_join(Players, by = c('PlayerID' = 'FantraxID')) %>%
    left_join(Dates, by = c('Year', 'Period' = 'Day')) %>%
    left_join(IllegalRosters, by = c('Team', 'Year', 'Period' = 'Day')) %>%
    filter(is.na(Illegal == T)) %>%
    select(Team, ESPNPlayer, Date) %>%
    left_join(GameData, by = c('ESPNPlayer' = 'athlete_display_name', 'Date' = 'game_date')) %>%
    filter(is.na(minutes) == F) %>%
    mutate(plus_minus = as.numeric(plus_minus)) %>%
    group_by(Team) %>%
    summarize(PM = sum(plus_minus),
              FGM2 = sum(field_goals_made)-sum(three_point_field_goals_made),
              FGA2 = sum(field_goals_attempted)-sum(three_point_field_goals_attempted),
              FGM3 = sum(three_point_field_goals_made),
              FGA3 = sum(three_point_field_goals_attempted),
              AST = sum(assists),
              BLK = sum(blocks),
              DREB = sum(defensive_rebounds),
              FTA = sum(free_throws_attempted),
              FTM = sum(free_throws_made),
              MP = sum(minutes),
              OREB = sum(offensive_rebounds),
              PTS = sum(points),
              STL = sum(steals),
              TOV = sum(turnovers)) %>%
    mutate(FGp2 = ifelse(FGA2 >= 10 & FTA >= 10 & FGA3 >= 10, FGM2/FGA2, 0),
           FGp3 = ifelse(FGA2 >= 10 & FTA >= 10 & FGA3 >= 10, FGM3/FGA3, 0),
           FTp = ifelse(FGA2 >= 10 & FTA >= 10 & FGA3 >= 10, FTM/FTA, 0),
           TSp = ifelse(FGA2 >= 10 & FGA3 >= 10 & FTA >= 10, PTS/(2*(FGA2+FGA3+0.44*FTA)), 0),
           Year = GameYear,
           Period = GamePeriod) %>%
    select(Period, Year, Team, MP, TSp, FGM2, FGA2, FGp2, FGM3, FGA3, FGp3, FTM, FTA, FTp, PTS, OREB, DREB, AST, STL, BLK, TOV, PM)
  
  print(TeamAResults)
}

B <- data.frame()
C <- Sys.time()
for(i in 1:nrow(ScheduleLong)) {
  A <- GetGameStats(i)
  B <- rbind(A,B)
  D <- paste(i, Sys.time()-C)
  print(D)}

rm(list = ls())
```

```{r Player Career}
AllPlayers <- unique(GameData$athlete_display_name)
SeasonTypes <- unique(Schedule$Season)
combos <- expand.grid(Player = AllPlayers, SeasonType = SeasonTypes)

GetCareerStats <- function(Player, Input2) {
  df <- GameData %>%
    filter(athlete_display_name == Player) %>%
    left_join(Players, by = c('athlete_display_name' = 'ESPNPlayer')) %>%
    left_join(Schedule, by = c('game_date' = 'Date')) %>%
    filter(Season == Input2) %>%
    left_join(Rosters, by = c('FantraxID' = 'PlayerID', 'Year', 'Day' = 'Period')) %>%
    filter(Status == "ACTIVE") %>%
    left_join(Games, by = c('Period', 'Year', 'Team' = 'TeamA')) %>%
    left_join(Games, by = c('Period', 'Year', 'Team' = 'TeamB')) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Round.x) | !is.na(Round.y)) %>%
    select(1:69) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    filter(!is.na(minutes)) %>%
    arrange(game_date)

  # Exit early if no data
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

  PlayerData <- df %>%
    mutate(row_id = 1:n()) %>%
    group_by(Team, Year) %>%
    summarize(
      GP = n(),
      PM = round(mean(as.numeric(plus_minus)), 2),
      FGM2 = round(mean(field_goals_made - three_point_field_goals_made), 2),
      FGA2 = round(mean(field_goals_attempted - three_point_field_goals_attempted), 2),
      FGM3 = round(mean(three_point_field_goals_made), 2),
      FGA3 = round(mean(three_point_field_goals_attempted), 2),
      AST = round(mean(assists), 2),
      BLK = round(mean(blocks), 2),
      DREB = round(mean(defensive_rebounds), 2),
      FTA = round(mean(free_throws_attempted), 2),
      FTM = round(mean(free_throws_made), 2),
      MP = round(mean(minutes), 2),
      OREB = round(mean(offensive_rebounds), 2),
      PTS = round(mean(points), 2),
      STL = round(mean(steals), 2),
      TOV = round(mean(turnovers), 2),
      Row = min(row_id),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(Row)

  PlayerData2 <- df %>%
    mutate(row_id = 1:n() + 0.1) %>%
    group_by(Year) %>%
    summarize(
      GP = n(),
      PM = round(mean(as.numeric(plus_minus)), 2),
      FGM2 = round(mean(field_goals_made - three_point_field_goals_made), 2),
      FGA2 = round(mean(field_goals_attempted - three_point_field_goals_attempted), 2),
      FGM3 = round(mean(three_point_field_goals_made), 2),
      FGA3 = round(mean(three_point_field_goals_attempted), 2),
      AST = round(mean(assists), 2),
      BLK = round(mean(blocks), 2),
      DREB = round(mean(defensive_rebounds), 2),
      FTA = round(mean(free_throws_attempted), 2),
      FTM = round(mean(free_throws_made), 2),
      MP = round(mean(minutes), 2),
      OREB = round(mean(offensive_rebounds), 2),
      PTS = round(mean(points), 2),
      STL = round(mean(steals), 2),
      TOV = round(mean(turnovers), 2),
      Row = max(row_id),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Team = "Total")

  PlayerData <- bind_rows(PlayerData, PlayerData2)

  PlayerData <- PlayerData %>%
    group_by(Year) %>%
    mutate(Total = n()) %>%
    filter(Team != "Total" | Total != 2) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      `2P%` = round(FGM2 / FGA2, 4),
      `3P%` = round(FGM3 / FGA3, 4),
      `FT%` = round(FTM / FTA, 4),
      `TS%` = round(PTS / (2 * (FGA2 + FGA3 + 0.44 * FTA)), 4),
      `2P` = paste0(FGM2, "/", FGA2),
      `3P` = paste0(FGM3, "/", FGA3),
      `FT` = paste0(FTM, "/", FTA),
      PM = ifelse(PM >= 0, paste0("+", PM), as.character(PM))
    ) %>%
    arrange(Row) %>%
    left_join(TeamInfo, by = "Team") %>%
    mutate(
      PlayerName = Player,
      SeasonType = Input2
    ) %>%
    select(PlayerName, SeasonType, Team, Year, GP, MP, `TS%`, `2P`, `2P%`, `3P`, `3P%`, FT, `FT%`,
           PTS, OREB, DREB, AST, STL, BLK, TOV, PM, Color1, Color3) %>%
    filter(!Team %in% c("Overseas Players One", "Overseas Players Two"))

  return(PlayerData)
}
```

```{r Get Standings}
Team <- unique(Games$TeamA)
TeamSummary <- data.frame(Team)
TeamSummary <- TeamSummary %>%
  filter(is.na(Team) == F)

ordinal <- function(n) {
  suffix <- ifelse(n %% 100 %in% 11:13, "th",
                   ifelse(n %% 10 == 1, "st",
                          ifelse(n %% 10 == 2, "nd",
                                 ifelse(n %% 10 == 3, "rd", "th"))))
  paste0(n, suffix)
}

YStandings <- Games %>%
  filter(is.na(TeamA) == F) %>%
  mutate(Winner = ifelse(TeamBScore >= TeamAScore, TeamB, TeamA)) %>%
  filter(Round == "Regular") %>%
  group_by(Winner, Year) %>%
  summarize(Wins = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Losses = case_when(
                    Year == 2021 ~ 62,
                    Year %in% c(2022, 2023) ~ 76,
                    Year >= 2024 ~ 72),
         Losses = Losses-Wins)


DStandings <- Games %>%
  filter(is.na(TeamA) == F) %>%
  mutate(DWinner = ifelse(TeamBScore >= TeamAScore, TeamB, TeamA)) %>%
  filter(Round == "Regular") %>%
  filter(DivGame == TRUE) %>%
  group_by(DWinner, Year) %>%
  summarize(DWins = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(DLosses = case_when(
    Year == 2021 ~ 16,
    Year %in% c(2022, 2023) ~ 16,
    Year >= 2024 ~ 12),
    DLosses = DLosses-DWins)

CStandings <- Games %>%
  filter(is.na(TeamA) == F) %>%
  mutate(CWinner = ifelse(TeamBScore >= TeamAScore, TeamB, TeamA)) %>%
  filter(Round == "Regular") %>%
  filter(ConfGame == TRUE) %>%
  group_by(CWinner, Year) %>%
  summarize(CWins = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(CLosses = case_when(
    Year == 2021 ~ 32,
    Year %in% c(2022, 2023) ~ 46,
    Year >= 2024 ~ 42),
    CLosses = CLosses-CWins)

IStandings23 <- Games %>%
  filter(is.na(TeamA) == F) %>%
  mutate(IWinner = ifelse(TeamBScore >= TeamAScore, TeamB, TeamA)) %>%
  filter(Round == "Group Stage") %>%
  filter(Year == 2024) %>%
  group_by(IWinner, Year) %>%
  summarize(IWins = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(ILosses = 4-IWins) %>%
  left_join(TeamInfo, by = c("IWinner" = "Team")) %>%
  group_by(Cup2023) %>%
  mutate(Rk = rank(-IWins, ties.method = "min")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Rk, Year, Cup2023) %>%
  mutate(ILabel = if(n() > 1) paste0("T-", ordinal(Rk)) else ordinal(Rk)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(IWinner, Year, IWins, ILosses, ILabel)
  

IStandings24 <- Games %>%
  filter(is.na(TeamA) == F) %>%
  mutate(IWinner = ifelse(TeamBScore >= TeamAScore, TeamB, TeamA)) %>%
  filter(Round == "Group Stage") %>%
  filter(Year == 2025) %>%
  group_by(IWinner, Year) %>%
  summarize(IWins = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(ILosses = 4-IWins) %>%
  left_join(TeamInfo, by = c("IWinner" = "Team")) %>%
  group_by(Cup2024) %>%
  mutate(Rk = rank(-IWins, ties.method = "min")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Rk, Year, Cup2024) %>%
  mutate(ILabel = if(n() > 1) paste0("T-", ordinal(Rk)) else ordinal(Rk)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(IWinner, Year, IWins, ILosses, ILabel)

IStandings <- rbind(IStandings23, IStandings24)

TotalStandings <- YStandings %>%
  left_join(CStandings, by = c('Winner' = 'CWinner', 'Year')) %>%
  left_join(DStandings, by = c('Winner' = 'DWinner', 'Year')) %>%
  left_join(IStandings, by = c('Winner' = 'IWinner', 'Year')) %>%
  mutate(IWins = ifelse(is.na(IWins) == T & Year >= 2024, 0, IWins),
         ILosses = ifelse(is.na(ILosses) == T & Year >= 2024, 4, ILosses),
         ILabel = ifelse(IWins == 0, "5th", ILabel)) %>%
group_by(Year) %>%
  mutate(Rk = rank(-Wins, ties.method = "min")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Rk, Year) %>%
  mutate(YLabel = if(n() > 1) paste0("T-", ordinal(Rk)) else ordinal(Rk)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-Rk) %>%
  mutate(YRecord = paste0(Wins,"-",Losses),
         CRecord = paste0(CWins,"-",CLosses),
         DRecord = paste0(DWins,"-",DLosses),
         IRecord = paste0(IWins,"-",ILosses),
         IRecord = ifelse(IRecord == "NA-NA", NA, IRecord)) %>%
  select(-IWins, -ILosses, -CWins, -CLosses, -DWins, -DLosses) %>%
left_join(TeamInfo, by = c("Winner" = "Team")) %>%
  group_by(Division, Year) %>%
  mutate(Rk = rank(-Wins, ties.method = "min")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Rk, Year, Division) %>%
  mutate(DLabel = if(n() > 1) paste0("T-", ordinal(Rk)) else ordinal(Rk)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(1:10,28) %>%
left_join(TeamInfo, by = c("Winner" = "Team")) %>%
  group_by(Conference, Year) %>%
  mutate(Rk = rank(-Wins, ties.method = "min")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Rk, Year, Conference) %>%
  mutate(CLabel = if(n() > 1) paste0("T-", ordinal(Rk)) else ordinal(Rk)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Year, Winner, YRecord, YLabel, CLabel, DLabel, CRecord, DRecord, IRecord, ILabel)

sheet_write(data = TotalStandings, ss = "1yQFnD0MK0cjO68_Mri6N115EmblyDW7Bza2hbY9Rerg", sheet = "Standings")

rm(list = ls())
```

```{r Record Matrix}
  Games2 <- Games %>%
    filter(Type == "Regular Season") %>%
    mutate(TeamA2 = ifelse(TeamA < TeamB, TeamA, TeamB),
           TeamB2 = ifelse(TeamB < TeamA, TeamA, TeamB),
           Winner = ifelse(TeamBScore >= TeamAScore, TeamB, TeamA),
           WinnerA = ifelse(Winner == TeamA2, 1, 0),
           WinnerB = ifelse(Winner == TeamB2, 1, 0)) %>%
    group_by(TeamA2, TeamB2) %>%
    summarize(WinnerA = sum(WinnerA),
              WinnerB = sum(WinnerB)) %>%
    filter(TeamA2 != "Overseas Players One") %>%
    ungroup()
  Games3 <- Games2 %>%
    rename(TeamB2 = TeamA2,
           TeamA2 = TeamB2,
           WinnerA = WinnerB,
           WinnerB = WinnerA)
  Games2 <- rbind(Games2,Games3)
  Games2 <- Games2 %>%
    mutate(Record = paste0(WinnerA,"-",WinnerB)) %>%
    left_join(TeamInfo, by = c('TeamB2' = 'Team')) %>%
    select(TeamA2, Abb, Record) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Abb, values_from = Record) %>%
    left_join(TeamInfo, by = c('TeamA2' = 'Team')) %>%
    select(Logo, City, Nickname, 31, 2:30)
```

```{r TeamTotalStats}
ordinal <- function(n) {
  suffix <- ifelse(n %% 100 %in% 11:13, "th",
                   ifelse(n %% 10 == 1, "st",
                          ifelse(n %% 10 == 2, "nd",
                                 ifelse(n %% 10 == 3, "rd", "th"))))
  paste0(n, suffix)
}

TeamTotalStats <- GameData %>%
  left_join(Players, by = c('athlete_display_name' = 'ESPNPlayer')) %>%
  left_join(Schedule, by = c('game_date' = 'Date')) %>%
  left_join(Rosters, by = c('FantraxID' = 'PlayerID', 'Year', 'Day' = 'Period')) %>%
  filter(Status == "ACTIVE") %>%
  filter(Team != "Overseas Players One") %>%
  filter(Team != "Overseas Players Two") %>%
  filter(minutes >= 1) %>%
  filter(Season == "Regular") %>%
  group_by(Year, Team) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(GP = n(),
                    PM = round(sum(as.numeric(plus_minus)), 2),
                    FGM2 = round(sum(field_goals_made - three_point_field_goals_made), 2),
                    FGA2 = round(sum(field_goals_attempted - three_point_field_goals_attempted), 2),
                    FGM3 = round(sum(three_point_field_goals_made), 2),
                    FGA3 = round(sum(three_point_field_goals_attempted), 2),
                    AST = round(sum(assists), 2),
                    BLK = round(sum(blocks), 2),
                    DREB = round(sum(defensive_rebounds), 2),
                    FTA = round(sum(free_throws_attempted), 2),
                    FTM = round(sum(free_throws_made), 2),
                    MP = round(sum(minutes), 2),
                    OREB = round(sum(offensive_rebounds), 2),
                    PTS = round(sum(points), 2),
                    STL = round(sum(steals), 2),
                    TOV = round(sum(turnovers), 2)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    `2P%` = round(FGM2 / FGA2, 4),
    `3P%` = round(FGM3 / FGA3, 4),
    `FT%` = round(FTM / FTA, 4),
    `TS%` = round(PTS / (2 * (FGA2 + FGA3 + 0.44 * FTA)), 4)) %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  mutate(Rk_GP    = ordinal(rank(-GP, ties.method = "min")),
          Rk_PM    = ordinal(rank(-PM, ties.method = "min")),
          Rk_FGM2  = ordinal(rank(-FGM2, ties.method = "min")),
          Rk_FGA2  = ordinal(rank(-FGA2, ties.method = "min")),
          Rk_FGM3  = ordinal(rank(-FGM3, ties.method = "min")),
          Rk_FGA3  = ordinal(rank(-FGA3, ties.method = "min")),
          Rk_AST   = ordinal(rank(-AST, ties.method = "min")),
          Rk_BLK   = ordinal(rank(-BLK, ties.method = "min")),
          Rk_DREB  = ordinal(rank(-DREB, ties.method = "min")),
          Rk_FTA   = ordinal(rank(-FTA, ties.method = "min")),
          Rk_FTM   = ordinal(rank(-FTM, ties.method = "min")),
          Rk_MP    = ordinal(rank(-MP, ties.method = "min")),
          Rk_OREB  = ordinal(rank(-OREB, ties.method = "min")),
          Rk_PTS   = ordinal(rank(-PTS, ties.method = "min")),
          Rk_STL   = ordinal(rank(-STL, ties.method = "min")),
          Rk_TOV   = ordinal(rank(TOV, ties.method = "min")),
          Rk_2Ppct = ordinal(rank(-`2P%`, ties.method = "min")),
          Rk_3Ppct = ordinal(rank(-`3P%`, ties.method = "min")),
          Rk_FTpct = ordinal(rank(-`FT%`, ties.method = "min")),
          Rk_TSpct = ordinal(rank(-`TS%`, ties.method = "min"))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(`2P`   = paste(FGM2, FGA2, sep = "/"),
            `3P`   = paste(FGM3, FGA3, sep = "/"),
            FT     = paste(FTM,  FTA,  sep = "/"),
            Rk_2P = paste(Rk_FGM2, Rk_FGA2, sep = "/"),
            Rk_3P = paste(Rk_FGM3, Rk_FGA3, sep = "/"),
            Rk_FT  = paste(Rk_FTM,  Rk_FTA,  sep = "/")) %>%
  select(-FGM2, -FGA2, -FGM3, -FGA3, -FTM,  -FTA, -Rk_FGM2, -Rk_FGA2, -Rk_FGM3, -Rk_FGA3, -Rk_FTM,  -Rk_FTA)

gs4_auth()
```

```{r}
PlayerAwards <- range_speedread(ss = "1yQFnD0MK0cjO68_Mri6N115EmblyDW7Bza2hbY9Rerg", sheet = "Player_Awards")

awards_key <- data.frame(
  award = c("All-NBA", "All-Defense", "All-Rookie", "All-Star", 
            "Player of Month", "Player of Week", "Champion", "MVP",
            "ROY", "DPOY", "6MOY", "MIP", "ASG MVP", "Finals MVP",
            "ECF MVP", "WCF MVP", "Cup Winner", "Cup MVP", "Rookie of Month", "Clutch"),
  icon_name = c("fas fa-star", "shield-halved", "baby-carriage", "star-half-stroke",
                "calendar-plus", "calendar-week", "trophy", "crown", 
                "baby", "shield", "chair", "up-long",
                "zap", "fire", "arrow-left", "arrow-right",
                "medal", "fire-burner", "calendar-check", "stethoscope")
)

award_order <- c("Rookie of Month", "Player of Week", "Player of Month", 
                 "All-Rookie", "All-Defense", "All-Star", "All-NBA", 
                 "ASG MVP", "Clutch", "MIP", "6MOY", "ROY", "DPOY", "MVP",
                 "Cup Winner", "Cup MVP", "ECF MVP", "WCF MVP", "Finals MVP", "Champion")

# Add order column to awards_key
awards_key$order <- match(awards_key$award, award_order)


# Function to normalize award names to match the key
normalize_award <- function(award) {
  case_when(
    str_detect(award, "^All-SBC") ~ "All-NBA",
    str_detect(award, "^All-Defense") ~ "All-Defense", 
    str_detect(award, "^All-Rookie") ~ "All-Rookie",
    award == "All-Star" ~ "All-Star",
    award == "Player of Month" ~ "Player of Month",
    award == "Player of Week" ~ "Player of Week", 
    award == "Champion" ~ "Champion",
    award == "MVP" ~ "MVP",
    award == "ROY" ~ "ROY",
    award == "DPOY" ~ "DPOY",
    award == "6MOY" ~ "6MOY",
    award == "MIP" ~ "MIP",
    award == "ASG MVP" ~ "ASG MVP",
    award == "Finals MVP" ~ "Finals MVP",
    award == "ECF MVP" ~ "ECF MVP", 
    award == "WCF MVP" ~ "WCF MVP",
    award == "Cup Winner" ~ "Cup Winner",
    award == "Cup MVP" ~ "Cup MVP",
    award == "Rookie of Month" ~ "Rookie of Month",
    award == "Clutch" ~ "Clutch",
    TRUE ~ award  # Keep original if no match
  )
}



player_season_icons <- PlayerAwards %>%
  mutate(normalized_award = normalize_award(Award)) %>%
  left_join(awards_key, by = c("normalized_award" = "award")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(icon_name)) %>%
  group_by(Winner, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    unique_icons = paste(icon_name[order(order)], collapse = ","),
    all_icons = paste(icon_name, collapse = " "),
    total_awards = n(),
    awards_won = paste(unique(normalized_award), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(Year, Winner) %>%
  select(Winner, Year, unique_icons)

sheet_write(data = player_season_icons, ss = "1yQFnD0MK0cjO68_Mri6N115EmblyDW7Bza2hbY9Rerg", sheet = "Player_Notes")
```
